summary.whatChanges: Moves the `turbo` devDependency to the pnpm workspace catalog and pins it there at `^2.10.12`, upgrading from the previous `^2.5.4` range. The lockfile is regenerated accordingly.
behaviorChanges: Turborepo resolves to 2.10.x instead of 2.5.x for local and CI builds
`turbo` version is now centrally managed via the pnpm catalog rather than declared inline in package.json
risks: Major-ish minor jump from turbo 2.5 to 2.10 could change task scheduling, caching behavior, or config validation in turbo.json
Lockfile shows a large net removal of entries (+80/-142), so transitive dependency resolution changed in ways not visible in the diff
Any tooling that reads the literal turbo version from package.json will now see the `catalog:` placeholder instead of a semver range
